atoms.b: We can use the rules we know to make sensible ((++decisions cakes)).

instruction.text: Lara wants to go out in the rain. Select the most sensible clothing for her.

feedback.correct: We know that rain makes you wet, so a waterproof coat would be sensible.

instruction.text: Lara wants to stop her ice cream from melting. Select the most sensible place to store it.

feedback.correct: We know that ice cream melts when it is too warm, so a cold freezer would be sensible.

instruction.text: Lara wants to go shopping. Select the most sensible payment to use.

correct.text: We know that shops only accept money, so a £20 note would be sensible.
correct.sound: We know that shops only accept money, so a 20 pound note would be sensible.

instruction.text: Select the rule that keeps people safe on the road.

b: Never look both ways before crossing the road.
++Cross the road when there is a green man.
Cross the road when there is a red man.

instruction.text: Use the rule to choose a sensible decision.

b.sound: Lara will not cross until the man is green.
Lara will cross the road even though the man is red.

instruction.text: Select the rule that keeps you safe in the sun.

b: ++Always wear suncream to protect your skin.
Never wear a cap or sun hat.
Always stare at the sun to damage your eyes.

instruction.text: Use the rule to choose a sensible decision.

b.sound: Lara puts on suncream before going to the beach.
Lara lies in the sun without putting any suncream on.

instruction.text: Select the rule that keeps you safe in the car.

b: Open the door while the car is moving.

instruction.text: Use the rule to choose a sensible decision.

b.sound: Lara will put her seatbelt on in the car.
Lara will jump around in her carseat.
